text:
Samir: quick follow-up from today's all-hands 00 two asks: (1) which customer segments should we prioritize for the next 12 months, and (2) what's the single-line pitch we want sales to use?

Aisha: short answers 00 prioritized segments: 1) AI-native startups & PLG teams, 2) mid-market platform/infra teams, 3) regulated enterprise (security/compliance).
Single-line pitch: 'A high-performance inference platform that makes LLMs predictable and economical across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Keep it simple for now. :sparkles:

Marco: quick tech angle to reinforce that pitch 00 emphasize runtime + smart routing + caching. e.g. "Serving runtime + routing + autoscale = predictable latency & cost". Avoid deep numbers in customer-facing lines.

Leah: for go-to-market copy, surface two measurable benefits: "consistent latency SLA" and "actionable unit-cost controls (batching, cache, quantization)". Marketing: turn that into a 1-pager and a battlecard.

Sanjay: noted 00 I'll own the one-pager + competitor battlecard. Top use cases to highlight: low-latency chat, retrieval-augmented search, high-throughput embeddings pipelines. Those resonate with buyers.

Samir: on competitors 00 should we name names in buyer docs or keep it high level?

Aisha: avoid gratuitous name-calling in external docs. Externally: emphasize outcomes and unique capabilities (unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, rollouts, measurable cost controls, SLA + private deploy). For internal sales training: prepare a competitor matrix (cloud managed endpoints, single-model API vendors, inference runtimes) with strengths/weaknesses.

Leah: roadmap confirmation 00 near-term product focus = (a) Dedicated autoscaling & predictable throughput, (b) Private deployment onboarding (streamline VPC/on-prem installer to ~30 days), (c) Console UX for cost/latency drills. Can we confirm timelines?

Marco: confirmed 00 dedicated autoscale sprint scheduled for Q2 (90-day delivery milestones), private deploy installer improvements targeted across two sprints, console drills will be iterative after that.

Samir: perfect, thanks. Can someone drop a short internal brief + link to the Sales battlecard when ready? :thumbsup:

Leah: will post the brief + link by EOD tomorrow. tagging @Sanjay to expect the first draft of the battlecard on Friday.

Sanjay: got it 00 will circulate draft and ask for quick reviews.

Aisha: thanks everyone for the fast clarifications. Keep questions coming in this thread if anything else pops up.

Samir: thanks 00 filing these into the product/gtm follow-up doc.
